title: AZENTA ANNOUNCES LEADERSHIP TRANSITION
summary: Azenta, Inc. (Nasdaq: AZTA) ("Azenta" or "the Company") today announced that current member of the Board of Directors (the "Board") Dr. Martin Madaus has been appointed interim President and CEO, and that John Marotta has resigned as an executive officer and director of the Company.
